meetup.title: Nangang Hardware Meetup #19: The first robot on a small line (Thursday, November 5, 2026)
meetup.text: Thursday, November 5, 2026, 19:00 to 21:30, Nangang, Taipei. This month's meetup is about putting the first robot on a small production line. Ben Walker, co-founder of Stride Mobility, talks about why an e-bike maker that still builds its frames by hand in Taoyuan wants a robot arm on the line, and what he needs from the first one. After the talk, an open bench: makers of robot arms, grippers and sensors are welcome to bring hardware and show it working. Free; register on this page.
